snippet.title: Flying Car Game – Full Gameplay, No Commentary (Free in Your Browser)
snippet.description:
A flying car, one button, four vibes. Full gameplay of Roadster Race, free to play in your browser, no download.
▶ Play: https://aristudios.fr/roadster-race/

0:00 Neon · Race (Hard)
1:19 Demo · Survival
2:36 Grid · Race (Hard)
3:20 Tokyo · Race (Hard)
4:39 24 Karat unlocked

Hold to take off, tap again in mid-air for a barrel roll. Boost if you dare: it burns the same compressed air that keeps you flying.

Three modes, solo or with friends:
• Survival: go as far as you can, with 1 to 3 lives.
• Coins: 1, 2 or 3 minutes, and every coin makes you faster.
• Race: 1,600 m against three AI drivers, or against your friends with an invite link.
Your best runs go into the worldwide Hall of Fame.

The Neon vibe and eight classic colours are free. Demo, Grid, Tokyo and 20 more skins are on aristudios.fr. Three legendary skins can't be bought, like the 24 Karat at the end of this video.

Recorded on an earlier version of the game: Coins mode and multiplayer came out afterwards.

Made by Ari Studios, an independent game studio in Lyon, France.

#flyingcar #browsergame #indiegame
